# Hermiq

> Schedule autonomous AI agents in Nextcloud.

Hermiq is an open-source app for the Nextcloud workspace, built on the @conduction/docusaurus-preset documentation framework. Hermiq brings autonomous AI agents to Nextcloud: define an agent, give it tools, and run it on a schedule — all inside your own Nextcloud. Agents, their memory and skills are stored as OpenRegister objects, so every run is governed, auditable and multi-tenant. Released under EUPL-1.2 and maintained by Conduction since 2026.

- [Use cases](https://hermiq.conduction.nl/UseCases): real customer scenarios the app solves.
- [Integrations](https://hermiq.conduction.nl/Integrations): which external systems and standards the app talks to.
- [Technical](https://hermiq.conduction.nl/Technical): architecture, data model, security posture, deployment notes.
- [User guide](https://hermiq.conduction.nl/user-guide): end-user documentation.
- [API](https://hermiq.conduction.nl/api): OpenAPI reference (when the app ships an HTTP API).
